response.overview: Alienated from his father, lonely twelve-year-old Kyle finds comfort in the warm, reassuring world of an old family sitcom. When the show’s kindly patriarch begins speaking directly to him through the television, Kyle believes he has finally found the father he always wanted. But as his fixation deepens, TV Dad’s comforting guidance takes a sinister turn, offering Kyle a path to a perfect new home…if he is willing to leave his real one behind.
response.title: TV Dad
